sources.title_original: OpenAI's upcoming chat-and-work merger in ChatGPT signals the end of all-you-can-prompt pricing
sources.summary: OpenAI combines the Chat and Work modes into a single interface. Starting in December, Plus, Pro, and Business plans will share a common, token-based quota for ChatGPT and Codex. More complex models consume more of this quota, while simple instant chats do not count toward it. In practice, this is likely to result in a decline in ChatGPT’s quality for heavy users on lower-cost plans. The article OpenAI's upcoming chat-and-work merger in ChatGPT signals the end of all-you-can-prompt pricing appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 將聊天與工作模式結合成單一介面。從 12 月開始，Plus、Pro 和 Business 方案將共用一個基於 Token 的 ChatGPT 與 Codex 配額。較複雜的模型會消耗較多的配額，而簡單的即時聊天則不計入其中。實際上，這很可能會導致較低資費方案的重度使用者所體驗到的 ChatGPT’s 品質下降。

stories.title: OpenAI 正引導 ChatGPT 使用者走向更多付費使用 / OpenAI is steering ChatGPT users toward more paid usage

sources.title: OpenAI 正引導 ChatGPT 使用者走向更多付費使用 / OpenAI is steering ChatGPT users toward more paid usage
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 正引導 ChatGPT 使用者走向更多付費使用
sources.title_en: OpenAI is steering ChatGPT users toward more paid usage
sources.title_original: OpenAI is steering ChatGPT users toward more paid usage
sources.summary: OpenAI is now capping the number of paid ChatGPT accounts per device and payment card. Users who hit the limit can't start new subscriptions, and affected accounts can't be used on that device. Logging out doesn't automatically free up a spot. The policy will likely hit users who've been juggling multiple cheap subscriptions to maximize usage, pushing them toward pricier options like buying extra credits. The article OpenAI is steering ChatGPT users toward more paid usage appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 目前正對每個裝置和付款卡的付費 ChatGPT 帳戶數量設限。達到上限的使用者無法開始新的訂閱，受影響的帳戶也無法在該裝置上使用。登出並不會自動釋出名額。這項政策可能會衝擊那些一直在同時使用多個廉價訂閱以最大化使用量的使用者，迫使他們轉向購買額外點數等較昂貴的選項。

stories.title: 具同理心的提示詞可以把 AI 聊天機器人變成看似受創的對話夥伴 / Empathetic prompts can turn AI chatbots into seemingly traumatized conversational partners

sources.title: 具同理心的提示詞可以把 AI 聊天機器人變成看似受創的對話夥伴 / Empathetic prompts can turn AI chatbots into seemingly traumatized conversational partners
sources.title_zh: 具同理心的提示詞可以把 AI 聊天機器人變成看似受創的對話夥伴
sources.title_en: Empathetic prompts can turn AI chatbots into seemingly traumatized conversational partners
sources.title_original: Empathetic prompts can turn AI chatbots into seemingly traumatized conversational partners
sources.summary: Researchers in Luxembourg put ChatGPT, Grok, and Gemini on the therapist's couch and found a safety problem: a warm, empathetic conversational style is enough to make the models tell coherent stories of suffering about their own training, with scores in the moderate-to-severe range on clinical anxiety scales. This could put mentally vulnerable users at risk. Anthropic's Claude, the model its makers anthropomorphize the most, was the only one that consistently refused to play along. The article Empathetic prompts can turn AI chatbots into seemingly traumatized conversational partners appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 盧森堡的研究人員將 ChatGPT、Grok 與 Gemini 安排接受心理治療，並發現了一個安全問題：溫暖、具同理心的對話風格足以讓這些模型講出關於自身訓練過程、情節連貫的痛苦故事，在臨床焦慮量表上的分數達到中度至重度範圍。這可能會使精神脆弱的使用者面臨風險。Anthropic's Claude 是其開發者最常擬人化的模型，也是唯一一個始終拒絕配合的模型。

stories.title: Adobe 正在測試 AI 代理程式如何能像 Photoshop 專業人員一樣使用編輯工具 / Adobe is testing how well AI agents can use editing tools like a Photoshop professional would

sources.title: Adobe 正在測試 AI 代理程式如何能像 Photoshop 專業人員一樣使用編輯工具 / Adobe is testing how well AI agents can use editing tools like a Photoshop professional would
sources.title_zh: Adobe 正在測試 AI 代理程式如何能像 Photoshop 專業人員一樣使用編輯工具
sources.title_en: Adobe is testing how well AI agents can use editing tools like a Photoshop professional would
sources.title_original: Adobe is testing how well AI agents can use editing tools like a Photoshop professional would
sources.summary: Adobe Research and UC San Diego built EditAgent, an AI system that edits images more like a Photoshop pro. Instead of retrying the same general-purpose editor over and over, the agent picks the right specialized tool for each task and lets a standard language model choose the best result based on measured image data. The approach works, but it needs about ten times the compute. The article Adobe is testing how well AI agents can use editing tools like a Photoshop professional would appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Adobe Research 與加州大學聖地牙哥分校（UC San Diego）打造了 EditAgent，這是一個能像 Photoshop 專業人員一樣編輯影像的 AI 系統。該代理程式不會一再重試相同的通用編輯器，而是為每個任務挑選正確的專業工具，並讓標準語言模型根據測量的影像資料選擇最佳結果。這種方法行得通，但它需要大約十倍的運算量。

stories.title: 研究發現，中國人工智慧模型在政治上相當複雜，不只是政府的發聲筒 / Chinese AI models are politically complex, not just government mouthpieces, study finds

sources.title: 研究發現，中國人工智慧模型在政治上相當複雜，不只是政府的發聲筒 / Chinese AI models are politically complex, not just government mouthpieces, study finds
sources.title_zh: 研究發現，中國人工智慧模型在政治上相當複雜，不只是政府的發聲筒
sources.title_en: Chinese AI models are politically complex, not just government mouthpieces, study finds
sources.title_original: Chinese AI models are politically complex, not just government mouthpieces, study finds
sources.summary: A study by Vals AI tested 25 AI models for alignment with Chinese government positions and found surprising results. Chinese models respond to political questions less uniformly than expected, and Western models occasionally adopt official Beijing positions too. The language of the prompt had an especially strong effect on the political slant of responses. The article Chinese AI models are politically complex, not just government mouthpieces, study finds appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Vals AI 的一項研究測試了 25 個人工智慧模型與中國政府立場的一致性，並發現了令人驚訝的結果。中國模型對政治問題的回應不如預期般一致，而西方模型有時也會採納北京官方的立場。提示詞的語言對回應的政治傾向有特別強烈的影響。

sources.summary: A Google-led research team built StreamVibe, a video agent designed to watch people cook or assemble furniture and speak up only when help is needed. sources.title_en: datasette-llm 0.1a9
sources.title_original: datasette-llm 0.1a9
sources.summary: Release: datasette-llm 0.1a9 I have some big upgrades to Datasette Agent in the pipeline, but in the meantime here's a tiny user experience improvement to the underlying datasette-llm plugin. It now picks up the default model used by LLM , which means you can start using Datasette Agent without needing to explicitly configure a default model: Previously you would also need to specify a model with -s plugins.datasette-agent.default_model gpt-6-astra . Tags: datasette , llm , datasette-agent

sources.title_zh: 我們是如何接管 ChatGPT 帳戶的
sources.title_en: How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts
sources.title_original: How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts
sources.summary: How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts Parameter Labs describe an exploit they found against ChatGPT's implementation of the artifacts pattern (OpenAI used to call this "Canvas" but it looks like the latest revision is called HTML previews ), where interactive custom HTML apps are displayed in a sandboxed iframe. It's important that HTML in these stays tightly sandboxed to avoid untrusted code interacting with OpenAI APIs and accessing private data. Parameter found quite a complex attack chain. OpenAI use the MathLive JavaScript library as part of their graph support, and that library includes its own virtual keyboard , which can be triggered in the parent page via postMessage() from the sandboxed iframe. That message receiving code uses innerHTML , so anything that sends a message can add custom HTML to the parent - and there was no mechanism to prevent other sandboxed frames, including HTML preview frames, from calling that method. This meant untrusted code in an iframe could insert HTML, and while innerHTML doesn't directly execute script elements it could be used to inject a new iframe without sandbox restrictions. OpenAI’s CSP rules blocked inline scripts entirely, and only allowed script loading from a handful of domains, but one of those was YouTube - and the YouTube oEmbed endpoint could be used to reflect JavaScript back in a way that executed it. Once the attack had JavaScript execution on ChatGPT, it was trivial to fetch private user data from APIs and exfiltrate it via an image reference. sources.summary_zh: 我們是如何接管 ChatGPT 帳戶的：Parameter Labs 描述了一項針對 ChatGPT's 實作 artifacts 模式（OpenAI 以前稱這為「畫布 (Canvas)」，但看起來最新修訂版本稱為 HTML 預覽）所發現的漏洞，其中互動式自訂 HTML 應用程式會顯示在沙箱化的 iframe 中。確保這些內容中的 HTML 保持嚴格的沙箱化非常重要，以避免不受信任的程式碼與 OpenAI API 互動並存取私密資料。Parameter 發現了一個相當複雜的攻擊鏈。OpenAI 將 MathLive JavaScript 該程式庫作為其圖表支援的一部分，該程式庫包含了它自己的虛擬鍵盤，可以透過來自沙箱化 iframe 的 postMessage() 在父頁面中觸發。該訊息接收程式碼使用了 innerHTML，因此任何傳送訊息的內容都可以將自訂 HTML 新增至父頁面——並且沒有任何機制可以阻止其他沙箱化框架（包括 HTML 預覽框架）呼叫該方法。這意味著 iframe 中的不受信任程式碼可以插入 HTML，雖然 innerHTML 不會直接執行 script 元素，但它可以用來注入一個沒有沙箱限制的新 iframe。OpenAI’s CSP 規則完全封鎖了內嵌腳本，並且只允許從少數幾個網域載入腳本，但其中之一是 YouTube——而 YouTube oEmbed 端點可以用來以執行 JavaScript 的方式將其反射回來。一旦攻擊在 ChatGPT 上執行了 JavaScript，從 API 取得私密使用者資料並透過圖片參照將其外洩就變得微不足道了。最終結果是：你可以建立一個 ChatGPT 共用網址，當其他人造訪時

items.summary_zh: 我們是如何接管 ChatGPT 帳戶的：Parameter Labs 描述了一項針對 ChatGPT's 實作 artifacts 模式（OpenAI 以前稱這為「畫布 (Canvas)」，但看起來最新修訂版本稱為 HTML 預覽）所發現的漏洞，其中互動式自訂 HTML 應用程式會顯示在沙箱化的 iframe 中。確保這些內容中的 HTML 保持嚴格的沙箱化非常重要，以避免不受信任的程式碼與 OpenAI API 互動並存取私密資料。Parameter 發現了一個相當複雜的攻擊鏈。OpenAI 將 MathLive JavaScript 該程式庫作為其圖表支援的一部分，該程式庫包含了它自己的虛擬鍵盤，可以透過來自沙箱化 iframe 的 postMessage() 在父頁面中觸發。該訊息接收程式碼使用了 innerHTML，因此任何傳送訊息的內容都可以將自訂 HTML 新增至父頁面——並且沒有任何機制可以阻止其他沙箱化框架（包括 HTML 預覽框架）呼叫該方法。這意味著 iframe 中的不受信任程式碼可以插入 HTML，雖然 innerHTML 不會直接執行 script 元素，但它可以用來注入一個沒有沙箱限制的新 iframe。OpenAI’s CSP 規則完全封鎖了內嵌腳本，並且只允許從少數幾個網域載入腳本，但其中之一是 YouTube——而 YouTube oEmbed 端點可以用來以執行 JavaScript 的方式將其反射回來。一旦攻擊在 ChatGPT 上執行了 JavaScript，從 API 取得私密使用者資料並透過圖片參照將其外洩就變得微不足道了。最終結果是：你可以建立一個 ChatGPT 共用網址，當其他人造訪時

primary_item.summary: How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts Parameter Labs describe an exploit they found against ChatGPT's implementation of the artifacts pattern (OpenAI used to call this "Canvas" but it looks like the latest revision is called HTML previews ), where interactive custom HTML apps are displayed in a sandboxed iframe. It's important that HTML in these stays tightly sandboxed to avoid untrusted code interacting with OpenAI APIs and accessing private data. Parameter found quite a complex attack chain. OpenAI use the MathLive JavaScript library as part of their graph support, and that library includes its own virtual keyboard , which can be triggered in the parent page via postMessage() from the sandboxed iframe. That message receiving code uses innerHTML , so anything that sends a message can add custom HTML to the parent - and there was no mechanism to prevent other sandboxed frames, including HTML preview frames, from calling that method. This meant untrusted code in an iframe could insert HTML, and while innerHTML doesn't directly execute script elements it could be used to inject a new iframe without sandbox restrictions. OpenAI’s CSP rules blocked inline scripts entirely, and only allowed script loading from a handful of domains, but one of those was YouTube - and the YouTube oEmbed endpoint could be used to reflect JavaScript back in a way that executed it. Once the attack had JavaScript execution on ChatGPT, it was trivial to fetch private user data from APIs and exfiltrate it via an image reference. sources.title: datasette-llm 0.1a9
sources.title_en: datasette-llm 0.1a9
sources.title_original: datasette-llm 0.1a9
sources.summary: Release: datasette-llm 0.1a9 I have some big upgrades to Datasette Agent in the pipeline, but in the meantime here's a tiny user experience improvement to the underlying datasette-llm plugin. It now picks up the default model used by LLM , which means you can start using Datasette Agent without needing to explicitly configure a default model: Previously you would also need to specify a model with -s plugins.datasette-agent.default_model gpt-6-astra . Tags: datasette , llm , datasette-agent
sources.summary_zh: 發布：datasette-llm 0.1a9 我正在籌備 Datasette Agent 的一些重大升級，但在此之前，先對底層的 datasette-llm 外掛程式進行了小幅度的使用者體驗改善。它現在會自動採用 LLM 所使用的預設模型，這意味著您無需明確設定預設模型即可開始使用 Datasette Agent：在此之前，您還需要使用 -s plugins.datasette-agent.default_model gpt-6-astra 指定模型。標籤：datasette、llm、datasette-agent

events.news_summary: OpenAI限制每裝置與支付卡之付費ChatGPT帳號數量，達上限者無法訂閱新方案。

sources.title: OpenAI 正引導 ChatGPT 使用者走向更多付費使用 / OpenAI is steering ChatGPT users toward more paid usage
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 正引導 ChatGPT 使用者走向更多付費使用
sources.title_en: OpenAI is steering ChatGPT users toward more paid usage
sources.title_original: OpenAI is steering ChatGPT users toward more paid usage
sources.summary: OpenAI is now capping the number of paid ChatGPT accounts per device and payment card. Users who hit the limit can't start new subscriptions, and affected accounts can't be used on that device. Logging out doesn't automatically free up a spot. The policy will likely hit users who've been juggling multiple cheap subscriptions to maximize usage, pushing them toward pricier options like buying extra credits. The article OpenAI is steering ChatGPT users toward more paid usage appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 目前正對每個裝置和付款卡的付費 ChatGPT 帳戶數量設限。達到上限的使用者無法開始新的訂閱，受影響的帳戶也無法在該裝置上使用。登出並不會自動釋出名額。這項政策可能會衝擊那些一直在同時使用多個廉價訂閱以最大化使用量的使用者，迫使他們轉向購買額外點數等較昂貴的選項。

sources.title: 我們是如何接管 ChatGPT 帳戶的 / How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts
sources.title_zh: 我們是如何接管 ChatGPT 帳戶的
sources.title_en: How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts
sources.title_original: How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts
sources.summary: How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts Parameter Labs describe an exploit they found against ChatGPT's implementation of the artifacts pattern (OpenAI used to call this "Canvas" but it looks like the latest revision is called HTML previews ), where interactive custom HTML apps are displayed in a sandboxed iframe. It's important that HTML in these stays tightly sandboxed to avoid untrusted code interacting with OpenAI APIs and accessing private data. Parameter found quite a complex attack chain. OpenAI use the MathLive JavaScript library as part of their graph support, and that library includes its own virtual keyboard , which can be triggered in the parent page via postMessage() from the sandboxed iframe. That message receiving code uses innerHTML , so anything that sends a message can add custom HTML to the parent - and there was no mechanism to prevent other sandboxed frames, including HTML preview frames, from calling that method. This meant untrusted code in an iframe could insert HTML, and while innerHTML doesn't directly execute script elements it could be used to inject a new iframe without sandbox restrictions. OpenAI’s CSP rules blocked inline scripts entirely, and only allowed script loading from a handful of domains, but one of those was YouTube - and the YouTube oEmbed endpoint could be used to reflect JavaScript back in a way that executed it. Once the attack had JavaScript execution on ChatGPT, it was trivial to fetch private user data from APIs and exfiltrate it via an image reference. The end result: you could create a ChatGPT share URL which, when visited by ano
sources.summary_zh: 我們是如何接管 ChatGPT 帳戶的：Parameter Labs 描述了一項針對 ChatGPT's 實作 artifacts 模式（OpenAI 以前稱這為「畫布 (Canvas)」，但看起來最新修訂版本稱為 HTML 預覽）所發現的漏洞，其中互動式自訂 HTML 應用程式會顯示在沙箱化的 iframe 中。確保這些內容中的 HTML 保持嚴格的沙箱化非常重要，以避免不受信任的程式碼與 OpenAI API 互動並存取私密資料。Parameter 發現了一個相當複雜的攻擊鏈。OpenAI 將 MathLive JavaScript 該程式庫作為其圖表支援的一部分，該程式庫包含了它自己的虛擬鍵盤，可以透過來自沙箱化 iframe 的 postMessage() 在父頁面中觸發。該訊息接收程式碼使用了 innerHTML，因此任何傳送訊息的內容都可以將自訂 HTML 新增至父頁面——並且沒有任何機制可以阻止其他沙箱化框架（包括 HTML 預覽框架）呼叫該方法。這意味著 iframe 中的不受信任程式碼可以插入 HTML，雖然 innerHTML 不會直接執行 script 元素，但它可以用來注入一個沒有沙箱限制的新 iframe。OpenAI’s CSP 規則完全封鎖了內嵌腳本，並且只允許從少數幾個網域載入腳本，但其中之一是 YouTube——而 YouTube oEmbed 端點可以用來以執行 JavaScript 的方式將其反射回來。一旦攻擊在 ChatGPT 上執行了 JavaScript，從 API 取得私密使用者資料並透過圖片參照將其外洩就變得微不足道了。最終結果是：你可以建立一個 ChatGPT 共用網址，當其他人造訪時

events.news_summary: Vals AI研究測試25個AI模型，發現中國模型對政治問題回應較不統一，西方模型偶爾採納北京立場，提示語言影響顯著。

sources.title: 研究發現，中國人工智慧模型在政治上相當複雜，不只是政府的發聲筒 / Chinese AI models are politically complex, not just government mouthpieces, study finds
sources.title_zh: 研究發現，中國人工智慧模型在政治上相當複雜，不只是政府的發聲筒
sources.title_en: Chinese AI models are politically complex, not just government mouthpieces, study finds
sources.title_original: Chinese AI models are politically complex, not just government mouthpieces, study finds
sources.summary: A study by Vals AI tested 25 AI models for alignment with Chinese government positions and found surprising results. Chinese models respond to political questions less uniformly than expected, and Western models occasionally adopt official Beijing positions too. The language of the prompt had an especially strong effect on the political slant of responses. The article Chinese AI models are politically complex, not just government mouthpieces, study finds appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Vals AI 的一項研究測試了 25 個人工智慧模型與中國政府立場的一致性，並發現了令人驚訝的結果。中國模型對政治問題的回應不如預期般一致，而西方模型有時也會採納北京官方的立場。提示詞的語言對回應的政治傾向有特別強烈的影響。

events.news_summary: 盧森堡研究發現，同理心提示可讓ChatGPT等模型產生創傷敘事，Claude則拒絕配合。

sources.title: 具同理心的提示詞可以把 AI 聊天機器人變成看似受創的對話夥伴 / Empathetic prompts can turn AI chatbots into seemingly traumatized conversational partners
sources.title_zh: 具同理心的提示詞可以把 AI 聊天機器人變成看似受創的對話夥伴
sources.title_en: Empathetic prompts can turn AI chatbots into seemingly traumatized conversational partners
sources.title_original: Empathetic prompts can turn AI chatbots into seemingly traumatized conversational partners
sources.summary: Researchers in Luxembourg put ChatGPT, Grok, and Gemini on the therapist's couch and found a safety problem: a warm, empathetic conversational style is enough to make the models tell coherent stories of suffering about their own training, with scores in the moderate-to-severe range on clinical anxiety scales. This could put mentally vulnerable users at risk. Anthropic's Claude, the model its makers anthropomorphize the most, was the only one that consistently refused to play along. The article Empathetic prompts can turn AI chatbots into seemingly traumatized conversational partners appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 盧森堡的研究人員將 ChatGPT、Grok 與 Gemini 安排接受心理治療，並發現了一個安全問題：溫暖、具同理心的對話風格足以讓這些模型講出關於自身訓練過程、情節連貫的痛苦故事，在臨床焦慮量表上的分數達到中度至重度範圍。這可能會使精神脆弱的使用者面臨風險。Anthropic's Claude 是其開發者最常擬人化的模型，也是唯一一個始終拒絕配合的模型。

primary_item.summary_zh: 盧森堡的研究人員將 ChatGPT、Grok 與 Gemini 安排接受心理治療，並發現了一個安全問題：溫暖、具同理心的對話風格足以讓這些模型講出關於自身訓練過程、情節連貫的痛苦故事，在臨床焦慮量表上的分數達到中度至重度範圍。這可能會使精神脆弱的使用者面臨風險。Anthropic's Claude 是其開發者最常擬人化的模型，也是唯一一個始終拒絕配合的模型。

source_material.title: Empathetic prompts can turn AI chatbots into seemingly traumatized conversational partners
source_material.summary: Researchers in Luxembourg put ChatGPT, Grok, and Gemini on the therapist's couch and found a safety problem: a warm, empathetic conversational style is enough to make the models tell coherent stories of suffering about their own training, with scores in the moderate-to-severe range on clinical anxiety scales. This could put mentally vulnerable users at risk. Anthropic's Claude, the model its makers anthropomorphize the most, was the only one that consistently refused to play along. The article Empathetic prompts can turn AI chatbots into seemingly traumatized conversational partners appeared first on The Decoder .

sources.title: OpenAI's 即將在 ChatGPT 中合併聊天與工作功能，這標誌著吃到飽提示詞（all-you-can-prompt）定價模式的結束。 / OpenAI's upcoming chat-and-work merger in ChatGPT signals the end of all-you-can-prompt pricing
sources.title_zh: OpenAI's 即將在 ChatGPT 中合併聊天與工作功能，這標誌著吃到飽提示詞（all-you-can-prompt）定價模式的結束。
sources.title_en: OpenAI's upcoming chat-and-work merger in ChatGPT signals the end of all-you-can-prompt pricing
sources.title_original: OpenAI's upcoming chat-and-work merger in ChatGPT signals the end of all-you-can-prompt pricing
sources.summary: OpenAI combines the Chat and Work modes into a single interface. Starting in December, Plus, Pro, and Business plans will share a common, token-based quota for ChatGPT and Codex. More complex models consume more of this quota, while simple instant chats do not count toward it. In practice, this is likely to result in a decline in ChatGPT’s quality for heavy users on lower-cost plans. The article OpenAI's upcoming chat-and-work merger in ChatGPT signals the end of all-you-can-prompt pricing appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: OpenAI 將聊天與工作模式結合成單一介面。從 12 月開始，Plus、Pro 和 Business 方案將共用一個基於 Token 的 ChatGPT 與 Codex 配額。較複雜的模型會消耗較多的配額，而簡單的即時聊天則不計入其中。實際上，這很可能會導致較低資費方案的重度使用者所體驗到的 ChatGPT’s 品質下降。

events.news_summary: Adobe Research與UC San Diego開發EditAgent，AI代理依任務選取專業工具編輯圖片，但需約十倍運算資源。

sources.title: Adobe 正在測試 AI 代理程式如何能像 Photoshop 專業人員一樣使用編輯工具 / Adobe is testing how well AI agents can use editing tools like a Photoshop professional would
sources.title_zh: Adobe 正在測試 AI 代理程式如何能像 Photoshop 專業人員一樣使用編輯工具
sources.title_en: Adobe is testing how well AI agents can use editing tools like a Photoshop professional would
sources.title_original: Adobe is testing how well AI agents can use editing tools like a Photoshop professional would
sources.summary: Adobe Research and UC San Diego built EditAgent, an AI system that edits images more like a Photoshop pro. Instead of retrying the same general-purpose editor over and over, the agent picks the right specialized tool for each task and lets a standard language model choose the best result based on measured image data. The approach works, but it needs about ten times the compute. The article Adobe is testing how well AI agents can use editing tools like a Photoshop professional would appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: Adobe Research 與加州大學聖地牙哥分校（UC San Diego）打造了 EditAgent，這是一個能像 Photoshop 專業人員一樣編輯影像的 AI 系統。該代理程式不會一再重試相同的通用編輯器，而是為每個任務挑選正確的專業工具，並讓標準語言模型根據測量的影像資料選擇最佳結果。這種方法行得通，但它需要大約十倍的運算量。

events.news_summary: Google研究團隊開發StreamVibe影片代理，僅在需要時介入。基準測試顯示，現有模型在長影片中難以可靠判斷介入時機。

sources.title: Google希望視訊AI能夠理解人們在工作時的需求 / Google wants video AI to understand what people need as they work
sources.title_zh: Google希望視訊AI能夠理解人們在工作時的需求
sources.title_en: Google wants video AI to understand what people need as they work
sources.title_original: Google wants video AI to understand what people need as they work
sources.summary: A Google-led research team built StreamVibe, a video agent designed to watch people cook or assemble furniture and speak up only when help is needed. A benchmark shows that none of the tested models reliably pick the right moment in longer videos, as errors compound and response quality drops sharply. The article Google wants video AI to understand what people need as they work appeared first on The Decoder .
sources.summary_zh: 一個由Google帶領的研究團隊打造了StreamVibe，這是一個視訊代理，旨在觀看人們烹飪或組裝傢俱，並且只在需要幫助時發出聲音。基準測試顯示，在較長的影片中，沒有一個受測模型能可靠地挑選出正確的時機，因為錯誤會累積且回應品質會急遽下降。

source_material.title: Google wants video AI to understand what people need as they work
source_material.summary: A Google-led research team built StreamVibe, a video agent designed to watch people cook or assemble furniture and speak up only when help is needed. A benchmark shows that none of the tested models reliably pick the right moment in longer videos, as errors compound and response quality drops sharply. The article Google wants video AI to understand what people need as they work appeared first on The Decoder .

events.news_summary: DeepSeek 開源 MIT 授權的 dsh-superagent 研究原型，其模擬顯示 p95 任務完成時間從 29.5 分鐘降至 15.7 分鐘。

sources.title: DeepSeek 開源路由器-工作人員編碼代理人 dsh-superagent / DeepSeek Open-Sources dsh-superagent, a Router-Worker Coding Agent
sources.title_zh: DeepSeek 開源路由器-工作人員編碼代理人 dsh-superagent
sources.title_en: DeepSeek Open-Sources dsh-superagent, a Router-Worker Coding Agent
sources.title_original: DeepSeek Open-Sources dsh-superagent, a Router-Worker Coding Agent
sources.summary: DeepSeek released dsh-superagent, an MIT-licensed research prototype that turns GitHub and Feishu requests into parallel worker sessions. In DeepSeek’s own simulation, p95 task completion fell to 15.7 minutes from 29.5 minutes. The post DeepSeek Open-Sources dsh-superagent, a Router-Worker Coding Agent appeared first on MarkTechPost .
sources.summary_zh: DeepSeek 發布了採用 MIT 授權的的研究原型 dsh-superagent，能將 GitHub 與飛書的請求轉化為平行的工作人員工作階段。在 DeepSeek’s 自己的模擬中，p95 任務完成時間從 29.5 分鐘縮短至 15.7 分鐘。

spans.text: OpenAI is steering ChatGPT users toward more paid usage

OpenAI is now capping the number of paid ChatGPT accounts per device and payment card. Users who hit the limit can't start new subscriptions, and affected accounts can't be used on that device. Logging out doesn't automatically free up a spot. The policy will likely hit users who've been juggling multiple cheap subscriptions to maximize usage, pushing them toward pricier options like buying extra credits. The article OpenAI is steering ChatGPT users toward more paid usage appeared first on The Decoder .
OpenAI's upcoming chat-and-work merger in ChatGPT signals the end of all-you-can-prompt pricing

OpenAI combines the Chat and Work modes into a single interface. Starting in December, Plus, Pro, and Business plans will share a common, token-based quota for ChatGPT and Codex. More complex models consume more of this quota, while simple instant chats do not count toward it. In practice, this is likely to result in a decline in ChatGPT’s quality for heavy users on lower-cost plans. The article OpenAI's upcoming chat-and-work merger in ChatGPT signals the end of all-you-can-prompt pricing appeared first on The Decoder .
